creativeThesis: A tangible choice keeps turning against the viewer: dice reveal their real faces, winning routes accumulate as equal outcome beads, and their moves finally become a circle.
viewerExperience: Choose immediately, track a rival entering the playing space, inspect six equally likely faces, then see each winning route separately before the circle resolves the puzzle.
emotionalTarget: Playful curiosity followed by a satisfying reconstruction, without gambling pressure or fake defeat.
visualThesis: Rounded, lit three-dimensional dice on a textured walnut surface. Diagonal depth compositions, close views and rotating fixed faces precede tangible face-wheel/branch proof. No standing matchup heading or probability rectangle. The outcome-bead ring anticipates the final counter-choice circle.

decisions.treatment: Original WebGL ray-intersected rounded cubes with fixed face glyph atlas, material light/shadows and code-authored tangible face tokens/outcome beads. No generated photographic dice, source figures or fake physical trials.

convergenceReview.conclusion: The bounded latest-approved set remains DevilsHole, FLIP, Vermeer and Craft; actual rendered references reinspected alongside V3. Prior voice/clarity is brand continuity. V3 static slots were convenience-driven weak application despite different object subject. New direction replaces the slot grammar, with prototype and complete rendered checks still required.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Four latest available approved/locked masters by actual decision-entry time: DevilsHole, FLIP, Vermeer and Craft. No performance/publication/domain filter.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: An object-led tabletop challenge with close material views and consequential face transformations; educational proof appears through the objects before a conceptual circular reveal.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Explored physical demonstration, flat illustrated theatre and spatial/graphic integration before rejecting the existing fixed-panel default. Selected treatment follows participation plus proof, not a handy dice engine or available assets.

ownerReview.rationale: Exact actual owner V4 revision explicitly authorizes a replacement under the preserved script and verification; routine revised direction within that scope. No master approval or publication authority inferred.

risks: Four identities and mixed-probability branches can overwhelm; later comprehension review must test retelling without a memorized table.
Every visible face/rotation must preserve the exact multiset; no guessed opposite-face convention, changing labels or apparent throw declared random.
Weighted branches are18+6 and12+12winning indexed combinations; neither value types nor illustrated rolls establish empirical frequency.
No physical fairness, subjective narration listening, audiovisual quality, rendered QA, phone/device safety or audience effect established at this stage.
Source figure copying, assets, audio, cube geometry, exact caption cues, ProductionPlan and renders require later authorization and provenance.

provenance.notes: V4 owner-directed visual revision; actual V3phone sheet and four latest approved-master render references reinspected. Exact editorial inputs preserved. Alternatives/recurrence investigation recorded under revision-v4; no external/paid/image provider asset.
